purpose: Every factual claim allowed on the VINSHO site, graded by evidence. Nothing outside this file may be stated as fact.

verified.usage: Free to use. This is the strongest asset the brand has.
Use exactly '29 years'. Never '29+' — the plus overstates a number that is precisely known.

verified.claim: Based at India Expo Plaza, First Floor, Plot No. C-03 & C-04, Knowledge Park-II, Greater Noida, U.P. 201310
verified.evidence: Footer on every page; Contact page; Google Map embed.
verified.usage: Free to use. Call it premises, showroom or office — see 'studio' under fabricated.

verified.evidence: About page FAQ: 'we offer all-India shipping'.
Site-wide top bar; About page FAQ.

verified.claim: Home furnishing, décor and gifting range of 50 products across 4 collections
verified.usage: Free to use. Derive counts from data.

clientClaimedUnverified.claim: Products reach homes in the USA, Europe and Australia
clientClaimedUnverified.exactWording: Proudly, our creations reach homes across the USA, Europe, and Australia—bringing VINSHO's charm to the world.
clientClaimedUnverified.appearsOn: About page only. Once. The homepage repeats the same paragraph but cuts off before this sentence.
clientClaimedUnverified.evidence: None. No export page, no IEC number, no shipping partner, no client logos, no case studies, no certifications anywhere on the site.
clientClaimedUnverified.ruling: This is the client's own words, so it may be repeated — but ONLY at their strength, not upgraded.
clientClaimedUnverified.allowed: Our creations reach homes across the USA, Europe and Australia
notAllowed: Any count of countries, shipments, orders or homes
clientClaimedUnverified.note: 'Reach homes' is not 'we export'. It could equally describe resellers, diaspora buyers or gifts carried abroad. Do not convert a soft sentence into a hard credential.

neverMentionedAnywhere: International tie-ups, partnerships, collaborations or joint ventures
Distributors, stockists, agents or overseas offices
Export licence, IEC code, GST number or any registration
Certifications (ISO, OEKO-TEX, GOTS, Fair Trade or any other)
Named clients, hotels, cafés or corporate accounts
Customer counts, order counts, homes served, revenue or growth figures
Team size, factory, manufacturing unit or production capacity
Customer reviews, ratings or testimonials — every product on the live site shows 0 reviews

fabricated.problem: No such figure exists anywhere on the site or in any material provided. It is invented.
fabricated.action: Delete. Do not replace with a smaller number — no number is verifiable.

fabricated.problem: It is exactly 29 years. The '+' inflates a precisely known figure.

fabricated.text: grown from a passionate studio ... into an internationally trusted brand
fabricated.problem: 'Passionate studio' and 'internationally trusted brand' are both invented. The one export sentence on the site does not support 'internationally trusted'.
The premises are at India Expo Plaza, a commercial complex. Nothing on the site calls it a studio, and no workshop or making process is documented.
fabricated.action: Use 'Greater Noida' or 'India Expo Plaza, Greater Noida'.

fabricated.text: our studio continues to champion artisanal quality
fabricated.problem: Implies in-house making. No evidence of manufacturing anywhere on the site.
fabricated.action: Remove or attribute to curation rather than production.

ruleForAllAgents: If a fact is not in 'verified', it cannot be stated. If it is in 'clientClaimedUnverified', repeat it only in the allowed wording. If it is in 'neverMentionedAnywhere' or 'fabricated', it does not go on the site in any form. When a section feels thin, leave a TODO — never fill the gap with a plausible-sounding number.
